'''''Mace Windu'' 3''' is the third issue of the [[2024]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Mace Windu]]''. The issue was written by [[Marc Bernardin]], illustrated by [[Georges Jeanty]], [[Dexter Vines]], and [[Andrew Dalhouse]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] on [[April 17]], [[2024]].

==Publisher's summary==
''ONE OF THE GREATEST JEDI MUST STOP AN EXPLOSIVE SECRET FROM FALLING INTO THE WRONG HANDS! On the refinery moon RO MIRA, MACE WINDU and smuggler AZITA CRUUZ – carrying the formula to a paradigm-smashing energy source – are on the run from Ro Mira's security forces and a HUTT-hired BOUNTY HUNTER. Can MACE dispatch a squadron of fighters led by the ruthless Anzellan YAYA SHRAM with nothing by his LIGHTSABER and THE FORCE? Introducing MURO and DIYA, DUSK WEAVERS OF THE HAD'LE PATH, a cult obsessed with wiping technology from the face of the galaxy!''

==Opening crawl==
{{OpeningCrawl
|name=THE RUN
|text=In the time before the fall of the Republic and rise of the Galactic Empire, Jedi Knights are
keepers of the peace. Before joining the Jedi Council, one brave Jedi travels the galaxy on a
daring mission. He's known as….

Upon returning from a daring undersea mission, Mace Windu was briefed on a new threat: Smuggler Azita Cruuz has taken a rare, dangerous
substance known as coaxium ultra and is looking to sell it to the highest bidder.

After tracking down the young pirate, Mace and Azita began working together to evade the various other smugglers and hunters looking to
get their hands on the rare material.

But there are other mysterious figures, watching from the shadows….}}

==Plot summary==
On the ice [[moon]] [[Ro Mira]], [[Jedi]] [[Mace Windu]] and [[smuggler]] [[Azita Cruuz]] emerge from the ice [[cave]]s and uncover Cruuz's waiting [[speeder]] hidden with a white tarp to blend in with the snow. As the two get in and speed off across the ice flats, Windu questions her on what she will do after selling the valuable [[coaxium ultra]]. Her plan is simply to survive. She lives a small life, only poking her head out of the sand every once in a while to restock her cargo and fill her [[fuel]] reserves. Windu thinks this sounds lonely, but Cruuz thinks otherwise and that it sounds perfect as she’s always been alone. She explains that growing up in the [[Haruun Kal]]'s [[capital]] [[city]] of [[Pelek Baw]], most [[youngling]]s have parents. Cruuz's parents died during the crossing, and she arrived an orphan. Due to other kids being cruel to her because she was different, she became her own best friend and took in the sunrises off the southern gas marshes and fished the shores of [[Lake Haruuni]]. 

The pair are interrupted by a pair of [[Ro Mira Refinery Security]] [[Starship|ships]] flying overhead. The ships open fire and purposefully miss the speeder, warning them to surrender and return the stolen property, and if they do then they will be pardoned of any crimes. With no other options, Windu tells Cruuz that he can get her out of this only if she agrees to sell the coaxium ultra supply and formula to the [[Jedi Order]]. When the smuggler agrees, Windu contacts the ships and introduces himself, saying that the speeder is now under Jedi protection, and any further hostilities will be considered as an act of aggression against the Jedi Order. After some time, the refinery authorities agree to yield to the authority of Windu and the Jedi Order, and they stand down and return to base. 

Just as things start to seem peaceful, both of the security ships are unexpectedly blasted out of the sky by the [[Anzellan]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Yaya Shram]] and her squadron of fighters. Shram alerts Windu and Cruuz that they have something that [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure|Jabba the Hutt]] wants, and begins to open fire on them, not caring that the speeder is under the protection of the Jedi. Not able to keep dodging their shots forever, Windu has Cruuz slow down, and he leaps onto one of the ships to disable it. As he leaps from ship to ship, he uses [[Mace Windu's lightsaber|his lightsaber]] to cut the ships apart, taking them out of the sky. Coming up on Shram's ship, Windu shatters the canopy of his cockpit, but Shram tells him that he has incurred the wrath of Jabba and Yaya before ejecting from the ship. With all of the ships destroyed and the threat gone, Mace returns to the speeder down below, just before the self-destruct of Shram's ship goes off. 

The two then travel to [[Ro Mira's Radial Spaceport]], and pay a man forty [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]] for speeder parking. As they prepare to board [[Azita Cruuz's freighter|Cruuz's freighter]], they are ambushed by [[Muro]] and [[Diya]], [[Dusk Weaver]]s from the [[Had'le Path]]. The Dusk Weavers pity their soon-to-be victims, readying themselves to deliver their anti-technology message through pain.
